sun_azimuth_deg.description: Sun azimuth, degrees clockwise from north.

sun_elevation_deg.description: Sun elevation above the horizon, degrees (0, 90].

turbidity.description: Turbidity: 2 = clear mountain air, 3 = clear, 6 = hazy, 10 = thick haze (2..=10).

exposure.description: Scale from kcd/m² to the written radiance (> 0): 0.05 puts a clear zenith near 0.5.

sun_radiance.description:
Radiance of the 0.27° sun disc after exposure (≥ 0; 0 hides the disc). The default is the
real sun — ≈ 1.6·10⁹ cd/m², i.e. 1.6·10⁶ kcd/m² × the default exposure — so an HDRI lights a
scene with the right sun-to-sky balance; in the map the disc's energy is spread over the
pixel that holds it when the pixel is larger than the disc.

width.description: Width of the equirectangular map in pixels (even, 16..=8192); the height is half.

path.description: Output `.exr`; relative paths resolve against the project's `exports/`. A `.png` preview is written beside it.
